subject: website
name: ENS
summary: The ENS manager app, open source (MIT). It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads Plausible's analytics script, Intercom's chat widget and WalletConnect's hidden verify frame. Names are read from the ENS subgraph and RPC endpoints.

connections.name: Plausible analytics and Intercom chat widget
connections.note: Loaded when the page opens, without asking.

connections.name: WalletConnect verify frame (verify.walletconnect.com)
connections.note: Loaded when the page opens, before any wallet is connected.
